title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – How to default a General Ledger account onto a Purchase Invoice using “Recurring Purchase Lines”
summary: Recurring Purchase Lines automatically default General Ledger accounts and other details onto purchase invoices when a vendor is selected, streamlining repetitive invoice entry such as monthly rent payments.
key_points: Create a Recurring Purchase Line by entering a code, description, GL account, and dimensions
Link the Recurring Purchase Line to a vendor with 'Automatic' setting to auto-populate invoice lines
This feature works for both GL accounts and items, and can be assigned to multiple vendors
Saves time and ensures accuracy by preventing manual GL code selection for recurring transactions

quotes.text: it would be great if the system would default the GL account onto the Purchase Invoice after you select the supplier.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core use case: automating GL account selection based on vendor to save time on repetitive invoicing

quotes.text: This is a great time saver and ensures the correct GL code is always picked up.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights both efficiency and accuracy benefits of the feature for transaction entry
